blocks.text: NAGOYA—Filipino swim ace Ernie Gawilan won the Philippines’ first gold medal at the 5th Asian Para Games in the Rainbow Pool at Nagoya City General Gymnasium. The 35-year-old Davao City native, who has underdeveloped extremities, swam as if there was no tomorrow, winning the men’s 400-meter freestyle S7 gold in four minutes and 56.72 seconds to brighten what had been a gloomy Philippine campaign early in the eight-day competition. He overcame a fierce challenge from China’s youthful Zhang Yilong and a familiar foe, Singapore’s Toh Wei Soong, who settled for silver and bronze with times of 5:01.36 and 5:24.23, respectively.
